title: Dynamic Online Pricing with Incomplete Information Using Multiarmed Bandit Experiments
authors: Kanishka Misra; Eric M. Schwartz; Jacob Abernethy
eligible_reason: Multi-armed bandit dynamic pricing policy evaluated in Monte Carlo simulations (including a calibration to Dube and Misra 2017 segment values). No empirical treatment, no DiD.
design_notes: Code/Code_For_MC_all_algoritms_run_MC.R and _MC_makesummary.R with all_function.R run the simulations and figures; DubeMisraReplication/ generates calibrated segment values. The archive also includes the paper's LaTeX source and published PDF (banditpricing_marketing_science.pdf); no 'difference-in-differences' in the .tex.
data_files_note: No empirical data; results come from simulated demand generated in the R code.
data_provenance_note: Simulation study; data generated in code.
screener_notes: No article text in data/text or papers/ (checked Nov 2), but the package itself contains the published PDF and LaTeX source; design read from the README, code and .tex; no package code was run.
